repair_proposal.explanation: The legacy payment write occurred after backfill_orders had completed without an active synchronization trigger. Consequently, legacy_status was updated to 'paid' while status_id remained stale at 1 ('pending'), violating status_consistency_invariant. Activating the compatibility trigger prior to backfill ensures that legacy writes synchronously update status_id, maintaining consistency across schema changes.
